verdict.rationale: Stripe documents programmatic dispute management: the API lets you upload evidence, respond to disputes, and receive dispute events via webhooks. Its hosted MCP server gives agents `stripe_api_read` for any GET method and `stripe_api_write`, with dispute updates explicitly listed among supported methods, so an agent can retrieve a dispute, attach evidence and submit through official tooling. Missing for 10: no evidence that file/evidence uploads are exposed as MCP tools, only thin docs on how evidence is structured and submitted, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent completing a dispute end-to-end.
